text:
maria: Quick sync — we're planning to cut v1.14.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can everyone confirm their repo is tagged and CI is green?

devin: SDKs all merged, just waiting on the docs site deploy (should be <30m).

alex: Runtime has one flaky test causing the GPU job to fail, trying a patch now. If it doesn't land by 18:00 PT flag me and I'll skip the test for the cut.

jen: Console changelog drafted, screenshots updated. Will push the PR for final review in 10m.

paul: API side: no schema changes, but need to bump the client deps. I'll open the dep PR after SDK tag is final.

maria: Useful checklist for tagging across repos: 
```
# tag flow
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "release v1.14.0"
git push origin v1.14.0
```

maria: Also please ensure package.json / setup.py have the version bump before tagging — it's easy to forget.

devin: @maria do we want the SDKs to reference runtime by semver ~1.14 or pin exact tag in the integration tests?

maria: For CI integration tests pin exact tag. For package deps use semver ~ or ^ depending on breaking changes. We'll pin in release notes.

ci-bot: [CI] runtime/main — 🔴 failed (flaky-test) — https://ci.redwood/in/17685/runtime/45

alex: re-triggered the runtime job, running with the flaky test disabled locally. Will update the PR.

release-bot: Release checklist: SDKs merged ✅, Console PR open (reviewing) ⚠️, Runtime CI failing 🔴, API deps pending ⚠️

jen: tagging console now; pushing v1.14.0 tag.

paul: opened API dep bump PR that points at SDK v1.14.0 tag — awaiting review.

maria: If runtime isn't green by 20:00 PT we'll proceed with a soft cut: tag and publish everything except runtime images, with a note in the changelog about runtime patch planned asap. Thoughts?

devin: fine with soft cut, we can do a quick hotfix release for runtime. Make sure SDK changelog notes the runtime exclusion.

alex: I should have a runtime fix by 19:30 PT. I'll ping here when CI is green.

maria: Perfect. I'll compile the release notes, include the exclusion clause if needed, and send the final publish command at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [CI] runtime/main — 🟢 passed (rerun) — https://ci.redwood/in/17685/runtime/46

alex: Runtime PR merged and tagged. Everything green from my side.

release-bot: All pillars green ✅ tagging across repos now in progress.

maria: OK team — final: everyone push tags, I'll run the publish script tomorrow. If anything blocks overnight DM me or ping #oncall.

devin: tags pushed for SDKs ✅

jen: console tag pushed ✅

paul: API dep PR merged and package bumped ✅

maria: thanks — closing thread.
